items.name: Finder
items.summary: A forward substring searcher using the Shift-Or algorithm.

methods.name: find
methods.summary: Return the first occurrence of the needle given to `Finder::new` in the `haystack` given. If no such occurrence exists, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new Shift-Or forward searcher for the given `needle`.
